about: Paper accounts (bullet, dated). Paper only: no account here ever sends an order (ADR-0001). Buying accounts take the bought-option version of each signal, selling accounts the sold-option version (setup id '<id>@sell'). An account takes a signal only from setups it accepts and only when its risk rules allow; every refusal is journaled with the reason. Capital Rs 5,00,000 each (Mandeep, 13 Nov 2026). Changing an account's money or limits needs Mandeep's say-so and a CHANGELOG line.

accounts.name: Shadow buying: every signal of every setup, option bought (grading only)
Sniper buying: index, only setups on trial or live, strict risk
Shadow selling: every signal of every setup, option sold against it (grading only)
Sniper selling: index, only setups on trial or live, strict risk and margin
